title: Shy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where each country has one superhero, 14-year-old Teru Momijiyama serves as Japan's hero, Shy, despite crippling shyness. After a failed rescue leaves a girl badly hurt, she sinks into depression and must rebuild her confidence with help from friends such as Russia's hero Spirit. The villain group Amarariruku corrupts people by drawing out the darkest feelings in their hearts.
life_message: Real heroism means reaching out to the hurting hearts of others, even when you are afraid and imperfect.
